m1_lifecycle.title: The ML System Lifecycle

stages.name: Raw Telemetry Ingestion
stages.desc: Validates schema, checks nulls, and ingests 6,953 sensor log observations.

stages.name: Data Preprocessing
stages.desc: StandardScaler for continuous sensors and OneHotEncoder for produce varietals.

stages.name: Feature Engineering
stages.desc: Calculates Magnus Dew Point (Td), Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD), and Q10 kinetics.

stages.name: Model Training & Selection
stages.desc: Trains 8 candidate classifiers and selects highest F1-Score pipeline.

stages.name: Model Artifact Packaging
stages.desc: Serialized pipeline + label encoder bundle prevents training-serving skew.

stages.name: REST API Serving
stages.desc: Low-latency sub-15ms endpoints for real-time and CSV batch predictions.

stages.name: Monitoring & Retraining Loop
stages.desc: Drift detection hooks and on-demand model retraining pipeline.

m1_lifecycle.training_serving_boundary: Prevented training-serving skew by embedding the fitted ColumnTransformer preprocessor directly inside the serialized Pipeline artifact.
m1_lifecycle.prediction_trace: HTTP Request -> JSON Payload Extraction -> Pipeline Preprocessing -> Estimator Prediction -> Psychrometric Calculation (Dew Point / VPD) -> Formatted JSON Response

m2_linear_depth.title: Supervised Learning: Linear Models at Depth
m2_linear_depth.interpretation: CO2 and Temperature carry positive log-odds coefficients (strongest drivers of spoilage), while controlled low humidity and darkness act as stabilizing factors.
m2_linear_depth.scaling_rationale: StandardScaler is strictly necessary for linear models to ensure gradient descent steps converge and L2 regularization penalties apply uniformly across units (°C, %, Lux, ppm).

m3_trees_depth.title: Supervised Learning: Tree-Based Models
m3_trees_depth.why_trees_excel: Random Forest and Gradient Boosting capture non-linear cross-sensor interactions (e.g., critical humidity thresholds at specific temperatures) without requiring manual interaction terms.

m4_unsupervised.title: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
m4_unsupervised.summary: PCA captures ~56.7% variance in 2 components, clearly mapping produce microclimates into 3 clusters: Cold-Preserved, Transitional, and Fermenting-Spoiled.

m5_evaluation_calibration.title: Model Evaluation, Selection & Calibration
m5_evaluation_calibration.calibration_status: Calibrated with Platt scaling to guarantee that a 90% confidence prediction strictly reflects a 90% empirical probability.

m6_engineering.title: ML Engineering: From Notebook to Production
m6_engineering.training_serving_skew_guarantee: ZERO SKEW: Identical pipeline code executed in offline training and live REST endpoints.
m6_engineering.drift_detector: Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) two-sample test comparing incoming batch distributions against baseline.
